_note: ALL values are working assumptions for the production-cost estimator; refine against BERC tariff orders, BPC fuel prices and BPDB annual reports before quoting results. Prices in BDT (Tk).
_heat_rate_source: typical net plant heat rates: CCGT ~51% eff, OCGT ~34%, subcritical steam ~36-37%, ultra-supercritical coal (Payra/Rampal/Matarbari) closer to 8.8 but blended with Barapukuria subcritical, HFO engines ~43%

_fuel_price_source.Gas: power-sector gas ~Tk 15/m3 (BERC; Tk 14/m3 set Jan-2023, assumed adjusted) / 37.3 MJ per m3
_fuel_price_source.HFO: furnace oil ~Tk 70/L / 39.7 MJ per L (LHV 40.5 MJ/kg x 0.98 kg/L)
_fuel_price_source.HSD: diesel ~Tk 104/L / 36.6 MJ per L (LHV 43 MJ/kg x 0.85 kg/L)
_fuel_price_source.Coal: imported bituminous ~USD 110/t landed x Tk 120 / 24000 MJ per t; domestic Barapukuria costs more

_import_tariff_source: assumptions from press coverage of PPAs: Adani Godda blended ~Tk 12-14.9/kWh, Bheramara HVDC long-term (NVVN/PTC) ~Tk 8.5-9, Nepal NEA 40 MW ~USc 6.4/kWh, Tripura ~Tk 9
